memory_update.text: The highest-priority AI Layer 1 universe should avoid a GPU-only framing and instead emphasize packaging/test, HBM yield control, photonics/CPO manufacturing, and reference demand anchors.
Advanced packaging, OSAT, probe cards, processor test, HBM inspection, and metrology are currently the strongest evidenced underfollowed AI chokepoint lane in the provided Layer 1B material.
Compound photonics and CPO remain a valid underfollowed discovery lane, but several company mappings require primary-source verification because evidence is mostly from secondary search context.

Layer 1 universe remains narrow because power, cooling, grid interconnection, data-center construction, and vertical AI automation software candidates were not visible in the provided Layer 1B excerpt.
Layer 2 should add current market-cap, liquidity, analyst-coverage, valuation, backlog, customer qualification, utilization, pricing, and capex checks before ranking investability.

summary: Merged Layer 1 AI universe emphasizes chokepoint exposure rather than headline AI ownership. The strongest initial clusters are advanced packaging/OSAT/test, HBM and processor inspection, photonics/CPO manufacturing constraints, and reference demand anchors. The universe is intentionally balanced: mega-cap leaders such as TSMC and Broadcom are retained mainly as reference demand and capacity signals, while most Serenity-ranked names are underfollowed or niche suppliers one or two steps away from the obvious GPU trade. Several candidates remain hypotheses because the provided evidence is node-level or secondary-source rather than company filing-level; these are retained with explicit hidden signals to verify in Layer 2.
